ingredients.item: Bone-in skinless chicken thighs and drumsticks

instructions: The night before, or at least 6 hours ahead, make the marinade. Grate the ginger and mince the 5 garlic cloves into a large bowl. Stir in 3/4 cup of the yogurt, the juice of half the lemon, 2 tbsp of the oil, 2 tsp of the Kashmiri chili powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 1/2 tsp garam masala, 3/4 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp black pepper and 1 tsp of the salt. Crush 1 1/2 tsp kasuri methi between your palms into the bowl.
Cut 3 deep slashes into each piece of chicken, down to the bone. Add the chicken to the marinade and rub it into the cuts. Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, or overnight.

Take the chicken out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking. Heat the oven to 470°F with a rack in the upper middle. Line a baking sheet with foil, set a wire rack on it and brush the rack with a little oil.
Lift the chicken out of the marinade, letting the extra drip back into the bowl, and lay it on the rack with space between the pieces. Keep the leftover marinade. Roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely chop the leaves from the mint until you have about 1/2 cup. Stir them into the remaining 1 cup yogurt with the last 1/4 tsp salt.
Thinly slice the red onion, cut the other half of the lemon into wedges and chop a handful of the cilantro.
Stir the last 1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder into 1 tbsp oil. Turn the chicken over, brush it with the leftover marinade and roast for another 12 to 15 minutes.

Turn the pieces back over and brush the tops with the chili oil. Move the pan under the broiler on high for 3 to 4 minutes, until you see charred spots. Watch it closely. You're cooking it to 175°F at the thickest part, so if you have a thermometer, check it there, away from the bone. No thermometer? Cut into the thickest piece next to the bone: it's done when the juices run clear and there's no pink.
Melt the 2 tbsp butter and brush it over the hot chicken. Sprinkle over the 1/2 tsp chaat masala and the chopped cilantro, and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Taste the mint yogurt. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of one of the lemon wedges.
Serve with the mint yogurt, the sliced red onion, the lemon wedges and rice or naan.
advance_prep_notes: marinate at least 6 hours, or overnight the night before
method_notes: All three slash bone-in chicken deeply, marinate it at least 6 hours in yogurt with ginger, garlic, lemon, oil, Kashmiri chili, coriander, cumin, garam masala and turmeric, and roast it on a rack over a foil-lined tray, basting with the leftover marinade. Swasthi's adds kasuri methi and black pepper, roasts hot at 470°F, turns the pieces once, broils for char and finishes with butter, chaat masala and cilantro. RecipeTin Eats starts at 350°F and bastes three times before a hot finish at 450°F and serves it with a blitzed mint yogurt; Tea for Turmeric adds tomato paste and melted butter to the marinade and bakes at 375°F before broiling. This one follows Swasthi's oven method and borrows RecipeTin's mint yogurt for the sauce, chopped by hand.
